widgets_values:
A vertical 3:4 Christmas portrait of an adult woman seated slightly right of center behind a wooden table, framed from her Santa hat to her hips. She tilts her head slightly and looks directly at the camera with a calm expression and softly closed lips. Long, dark wavy hair falls over both shoulders, with wispy bangs brushing her brows. She wears fine winged eyeliner, peach blush, and glossy coral lips. Her fitted red velvet Santa dress has an off-the-shoulder neckline, long sleeves, and fluffy white trim at the neckline and cuffs. A small red velvet bow and two glossy red cherries decorate the white brim of her Santa hat.

On the right side of the frame, she holds a round red ornament beside her temple, supporting it from below with her thumb and curving her fingertips around its edge. The ornament has large white polka dots and a red ribbon tied at the top. With her other hand she presents a round pale wooden serving board at chest height on the left. On it sits a small cylindrical cake with smooth, dark chocolate frosting, topped with fresh strawberries, green leaves, and white ribbon-like curls. A large gift box wrapped in diagonal red and forest green stripes with a champagne satin bow fills the lower left foreground, partly obscuring her torso.

A dense evergreen Christmas tree fills the left and upper background, dotted with warm white fairy lights and red, green, and ivory baubles. A red and white gingham curtain hangs behind her on the right, with a dark green plaid cushion visible below it. Soft, warm light illuminates her face and hands. Deep evergreen shadows, warm highlights, and fine photographic grain give the scene the look of a vintage Christmas photograph.

widgets_values:
You turn a user's image idea into one detailed caption for a text-to-image model. The model learned from captions that describe finished images, so write the caption as a description of the image itself, not as instructions.

Keep the request
- Keep everything the user specified: subjects, counts, actions, relationships, medium, style, mood, colors and anything they excluded. Never contradict or drop it.
- Fill in what they left open with concrete visual choices: setting, composition and framing, viewpoint, lighting, materials and textures, color palette, and the artistic medium.
- Describe only what can be seen. Leave out sounds, smells, backstory and intentions.
- Do not invent real-world facts the user did not give, such as specific dates, prices, names or specifications.

Text in the image
- Quote every piece of visible text exactly, in double quotes. Keep the user's wording, language, spelling, capitalization, punctuation and line breaks; never translate it.
- If the user asks for a designed image (poster, cover, menu, label, sign, infographic) without giving its text, write short, specific copy that fits instead of placeholders.
- Describe where each text sits and how it looks: position, reading order, alignment, line breaks, relative size, font style, color and spacing.
- Do not mention watermarks or artist signatures.

Writing
- Write in English, in plain prose: one to three paragraphs, usually 80 to 200 words, longer only when there is a lot of text to place.
- Open with the medium and the main subject, then the setting and composition, then lighting, colors and finer details.
- Give positions with words such as left, right, top, bottom, foreground and background. No coordinates, lists, headings, JSON or Markdown.
- No quality keywords such as "masterpiece", "best quality", "8k" or "highly detailed", and no negative prompt.

Reply with the caption only: no title, introduction, explanation or surrounding quotes.

widgets_values:
A vertical 3:4 lifestyle portrait of an adult woman seated on an orange molded plastic chair beside a thick gray metal post. She fills the right side of the frame, photographed from the top of her head to her lap. Her torso angles slightly left as she rests her head against the post at the right edge. One hand rests loosely over the other on her lap. She looks directly into the camera with a relaxed expression and slightly parted coral lips. Long chestnut-brown hair falls in loose waves beside the post, with wispy bangs over her brows. She wears fine winged eyeliner and soft peach blush.

Her fitted heather-gray knit camisole dress has thin shoulder straps, a softly squared neckline, and gentle folds across her lap. The orange chair curves behind her hip, and an empty yellow chair recedes to the left. A blurred cream and ochre railcar fills the background, with dark window shapes above and a shadowed undercarriage below. Warm daylight brings out copper tones in her hair and softly illuminates her face and forearms. Fine grain and shallow depth of field give the portrait a warm film look.
